thread:
incident-bot: ALERT: high GPU pool contention detected in us-west-2 (1760824567) - autoscaler unable to satisfy pending pods, queue depth rising, some user requests 504/timeout. paging on-call.

pam (on-call): I'm on the page. seeing sustained queue depth on inference-service; taking a look at node provisioning logs.

ryan (sre): grabbing handoff from pam. pam -> ryan. pam, leave notes of any quick fixes you tried. I'll keep the incident open.

pam (on-call): noted. I attempted a soft-burst: bumped dedicated-pool-usw2 by 8 GPUs (manual scaling). evicted noncritical batch workloads from two nodes.

leo (ops): manual burst completed: dedicated-pool-usw2 +8 GPUs (42 -> 50). cordoned nodes with high load to drain.

ryan (sre): initial mitigation applied; tail latency dropped for most tenants but errors persist for small percentage of requests. autoscaler logs show repeated "insufficient resources" while cloud shows nodes in provisioning state.

tina (platform): captured logs: our provisioner backoff interval increased after a transient 429 from cloud API, causing delayed node readiness. also found kubelet label mismatch on freshly provisioned nodes intermittently.

ivan (eng): I can reproduce with a scripted ramp. opening quick-fix PR to make autoscaler account for pending pods and relax backoff on repeated provisioning errors: https://git.internal/rw/autoscaler/pull/1052

ryan (sre): scheduling post-incident review. proposing 2-hour slot tomorrow 2026-03-19 15:30 UTC (invites to #eng-sre, #eng-platform, #ops, #product, #support). meeting link: https://meet.internal/rw/postmortem-1760824567

maya (cs): customer impact: 4 enterprise customers saw increased latencies for ~7-12 minutes; 1 customer reported API timeouts and opened ticket. communications drafted, will wait for final timeline.

zed (product): flagging SLA review and possible credit request. need timeline + root cause before sending final customer note.

ryan (sre): initial action items (owners + due):
- AI1: Hotfix autoscaler to include pending pod accounting (owner: ivan, due: 2026-03-19)
- AI2: Shorten cloud-provisioner backoff on transient 429s (owner: tina, due: 2026-03-20)
- AI3: Add early GPU saturation alert at 65% (owner: tina, due: 2026-03-18)
- AI4: Publish GPU shortage runbook and add to oncall rotation (owner: ryan, due: 2026-03-23)
- AI5: Reserve emergency buffer pool in us-west-2 (owner: leo, due: 2026-03-21)
- AI6: Customer follow-up and comms (owner: maya + zed, due: 2026-03-19)

ryan (sre): creating tracker tickets now. refs: RW-INC-4301 (postmortem), RW-TASK-8421 (autoscaler hotfix), RW-TASK-8422 (backoff tweak), RW-TASK-8423 (alerts), RW-TASK-8424 (runbook), RW-TASK-8425 (capacity buffer), RW-TASK-8426 (customer-comms).

ivan (eng): hotfix suggestion (snippet):
```
# autoscaler snippet
considerPendingPods: true
provisionerBackoff: 15s  # reduced from 60s on transient 4xxs
scaleUpMultiplier: 1.4
```

leo (ops): opened cloud request CT-11347 to provision temporary GPUs in reserved capacity; requested 25 GPUs for 14 days as buffer.

tina (platform): adding Prometheus rule GPU_POOL_EARLY_WARN (threshold=65% for 45s). will roll to prod after quick smoke.

maya (cs): drafted customer message, attaching timeline + next steps. awaiting review from zed before send.

pam (on-call): handoff: leaving to ryan at 12:18 UTC. all mitigation steps captured here.

incident-bot: INCIDENT STATUS: mitigated -> monitoring at 12:22 UTC. severity downgraded to P2.

-- Postmortem meeting 2026-03-19 15:30 UTC --

ryan (sre): summary: root cause = autoscaler not accounting for pending pods + provisioner backoff amplified by transient cloud 429s + intermittent label reconciliation on nodes -> resulted in delayed scheduling and tail latency.

ivan (eng): confirmed PR merged 2026-03-19 16:05 UTC (RW-TASK-8421 -> CLOSED). canary rollout looks good.

leo (ops): emergency buffer provisioned 2026-03-20 03:22 UTC (CT-11347 -> in-progress -> provisioned).

tina (platform): alert added and validated 2026-03-18 22:10 UTC (RW-TASK-8423 -> DONE).

ryan (sre): runbook draft published: https://docs.internal/rw/runbooks/gpu-shortage-handling.md (RW-TASK-8424 -> IN REVIEW).

maya (cs): customer communications sent 2026-03-19 18:30 UTC. one customer asked for SLA credit; routed to zed for review.

zed (product): reviewing credit request; will reply by 2026-03-22.

ryan (sre): closing checklist:
- autoscaler hotfix validated in canary (ivan) -> VALIDATED
- provisioner backoff tuned (tina) -> DONE
- early warning alert in prod (tina) -> DONE
- runbook published and linked to oncall (ryan) -> IN REVIEW
- capacity buffer finalized with finance (leo) -> IN PROGRESS
- customer comms handled (maya + zed) -> SENT / UNDER REVIEW

ivan (eng): canary logs snippet:
```
2026-03-19T16:06:12Z autoscaler: considerPendingPods=true
2026-03-19T16:06:16Z provisioner: requested 6 nodes
2026-03-19T16:06:41Z node-ip-10-3-88-72 ready and labeled
2026-03-19T16:06:55Z pods scheduled -> latencies returned to baseline
```
ryan (sre): final: RW-INC-4301 postmortem doc created. Owners, update JIRA tasks with status and close when done. We'll reconvene next week if any task slips.

pam (on-call): thanks all. handoff complete. :white_check_mark:
